verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly describe two headless routes: going fully headless with the documented GraphQL Storefront API, which has its own overview docs, and Catalyst, a first-party Next.js framework marketed as 'Headless Storefronts Made Easy'. A dedicated headless commerce solutions page backs this up. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of building a headless storefront with the GraphQL Storefront API or Catalyst, and the docs in the pack are mostly page titles and taglines rather than detailed coverage of storefront API capabilities.
